source_file: 01 Main MSP Manual/IASC MHPSS Minimum Service Package (English).pdf

rows.en: SUMMARY OF MHPSS MSP ACTIVITIES
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP अन्तर्गतका गतिविधिहरूको सारांश
rows.bt: Summary of activities under the MHPSS MSP

rows.en: The MHPSS MSP goal: Reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being among populations affected by humanitarian crises.
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP को लक्ष्य: मानवीय सङ्कटबाट प्रभावित जनसमुदायमा पीडा कम हुनु तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा सुधार हुनु।
rows.bt: Goal of the MHPSS MSP: Reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being among communities affected by humanitarian crises.
rows.note: Mental health and psychosocial well-being reuse the supplied unreviewed candidates T157 and T005.

rows.en: Sectors or AoRs typically well placed to deliver the activities
rows.ne: गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्न सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहेका क्षेत्रहरू वा जिम्मेवारीका कार्यक्षेत्रहरू (AoRs)
rows.bt: Sectors or areas of responsibility (AoRs) generally in a suitable position to carry out activities
rows.note: AoRs is retained. Proposed terminology for the recurring responsibility-area label is supplied separately for review.

rows.en: Sectors or AoRs typically well placed to contribute to implementation of activities
rows.ne: गतिविधिहरूको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान दिन सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहेका क्षेत्रहरू वा जिम्मेवारीका कार्यक्षेत्रहरू (AoRs)
rows.bt: Sectors or areas of responsibility (AoRs) generally in a suitable position to contribute to the implementation of activities
rows.note: The proposed AoRs wording is consistent with the preceding table heading and does not amend the frozen glossary.

rows.en: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.ne: खण्ड 1: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Section 1: Inter-agency coordination and assessment

rows.en: The humanitarian MHPSS response is well coordinated and responsive to the context, needs and gaps
rows.ne: मानवीय MHPSS प्रतिकार्य राम्रोसँग समन्वय गरिएको हुन्छ र यसले सन्दर्भ, आवश्यकता तथा विद्यमान कमीहरूलाई सम्बोधन गर्छ।
rows.bt: The humanitarian MHPSS response is well coordinated and addresses the context, needs and existing gaps.

rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors.

rows.en: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming
rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the programme.

rows.en: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: खण्ड 2: सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका आवश्यक अङ्गहरू
rows.bt: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programs
rows.note: The back-translation renders essential as mandatory. Replaced अनिवार्य with आवश्यक to avoid adding an explicit obligation.

rows.en: 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate MHPSS Programmes
rows.ne: 2.1 MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, योजना र समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate the MHPSS programme.
rows.note: The supplied ambiguity concerns an unresolved difference between this overview label and other activity labels; the local source wording is retained.

rows.en: MHPSS programs are well designed, monitored and evaluated and workers are supported
rows.ne: MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन राम्रोसँग गरिएको हुन्छ र कार्यकर्तालाई सहयोग प्रदान गरिएको हुन्छ।
rows.bt: The MHPSS programme is well designed, monitored and evaluated, and workers are provided with support.

rows.en: 2.2 Develop and Implement an M&E System
rows.ne: 2.2 अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणाली विकास र कार्यान्वयन गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.2 Develop and implement a monitoring and evaluation (M&E) system.
rows.note: The supplied ambiguity concerns an unresolved difference between this overview label and other activity labels; the local source wording is retained.

rows.en: 2.3 Care for staff and volunteers providing MHPSS
rows.ne: 2.3 MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.3 Care for staff and volunteers providing MHPSS.

rows.en: 2.4 Support MHPSS competencies of staff and volunteers
rows.ne: 2.4 कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.4 Support the MHPSS competencies of staff and volunteers.

rows.en: Section 3: MHPSS programme activities
rows.ne: खण्ड 3: MHPSS कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: Section 3: MHPSS programmatic activities

rows.en: Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS
rows.ne: मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient parties involved in humanitarian work and community members on MHPSS.

rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and action.
rows.note: The exact supplied activity candidate is retained, including its actor wording.

rows.en: Humanitarian actors and community members are oriented on MHPSS and equipped with basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू र समुदायका सदस्यहरूले MHPSS सम्बन्धी अभिमुखीकरण पाएका हुन्छन् र आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीप हासिल गरेका हुन्छन्।
rows.bt: Parties involved in humanitarian work and community members have received orientation on MHPSS and have acquired basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: The basic psychosocial support skills wording is reused from the unreviewed activity candidate T099, cited to MAN PDF p29 and PRIOR-SUM-29OCT2026 p.2 row 90.

rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.

rows.en: Strengthen self-help and provide support to communities
rows.ne: स्वसहयोग सुदृढ गर्ने र समुदायहरूलाई सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Strengthen self-help and provide support to communities.

rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.

rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already ongoing group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.note: Frozen T101 describes pre-existing activities as already operating, adding an operational-status condition that the source does not impose. bt-divergence: Frozen T101 renders pre-existing activities as already operating, adding an operational-status condition absent from the source. Frozen wording retained.

rows.en: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers
rows.ne: 3.5 साना बालबालिका र तिनका हेरचाहकर्तालाई सहयोग गर्न प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास (ECD) गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers.

rows.en: Affected communities have access to information and activities to promote their mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: प्रभावित समुदायहरूको आफ्नो मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने सूचना र गतिविधिहरूमा पहुँच हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Affected communities have access to information and activities that promote their mental health and psychosocial well-being.

rows.en: 3.6 Provide group activities for children’s mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.6 बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.6 Provide group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being.

rows.en: 3.7 Promote caregivers’ mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.7 हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.7 Promote caregivers' mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children.

rows.en: 3.8 Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education personnel and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.8 शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.8 Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education-sector staff and strengthen their capacity to support children.

rows.en: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through women and girls safe spaces
rows.ne: 3.9 महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.
rows.note: Frozen T054 and T106 narrow girls to adolescent girls, whereas the source does not exclude younger girls. bt-divergence: Frozen T054 and T106 narrow girls to adolescent girls, excluding younger girls whom the source does not exclude. Frozen wording retained.

rows.en: Provide focused support for people impaired by distress or mental health conditions
rows.ne: तनाव वा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अवस्थाका कारण दैनिक कार्यमा असर परेका व्यक्तिलाई केन्द्रित सहयोग प्रदान गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Provide focused support to individuals whose daily activities have been affected by stress or mental health conditions.
rows.note: Frozen T008 substitutes stress for distress and explicitly locates impairment in daily functioning, while the source does not specify that functional domain. bt-divergence: Frozen T008 substitutes stress for distress and restricts the impairment to daily functioning, a domain not specified in the source. Frozen wording retained.

rows.en: 3.10 Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: 3.10 सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.10 Provide mental health services as part of general health services.
rows.note: Frozen T107 renders mental health care as mental health services, potentially including services that do not provide care. bt-divergence: Frozen T107 renders mental health care as mental health services, broadening the activity beyond care to potentially include other services. Frozen wording retained.

rows.en: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of clinical care for survivors of sexual violence and intimate partner violence
rows.ne: 3.11 यौन हिंसा तथा घनिष्ठ साथीद्वारा हुने हिंसाबाट प्रभावितहरूको क्लिनिकल हेरचाहको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of the clinical care of those affected by sexual violence and violence by an intimate partner.
rows.note: Frozen T009 and T108 describe those affected rather than survivors, potentially including indirectly affected people outside the source population. bt-divergence: Frozen T009 and T108 render survivors as those affected, potentially including indirectly affected people outside the source population. Frozen wording retained.

rows.en: Persons impaired by distress or mental health conditions have access to care, protection and support
rows.ne: तनाव वा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अवस्थाका कारण दैनिक कार्यमा असर परेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई हेरचाह, संरक्षण र सहयोगमा पहुँच छ।
rows.bt: Individuals whose daily activities have been affected by stress or mental health conditions have access to care, protection and support.
rows.note: Frozen T008 substitutes stress for distress and explicitly locates impairment in daily functioning, while the source does not specify that functional domain. bt-divergence: Frozen T008 substitutes stress for distress and restricts the impairment to daily functioning, a domain not specified in the source. Frozen wording retained.

rows.en: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions
rows.ne: 3.12 मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेपहरूको व्यवस्था सुरु गर्ने वा सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.12 Start or strengthen arrangements for psychological interventions.
rows.note: Reuses the cited unreviewed activity-label candidate; clinical wording is not validated.

rows.en: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services
rows.ne: 3.13 केस व्यवस्थापन सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services.

rows.en: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions
rows.ne: 3.14 मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.14 Protect and care for people in mental hospitals and other institutions.
rows.note: Reuses the cited unreviewed activity-label candidate, including its institutional terminology.

rows.en: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.ne: खण्ड 4: विशिष्ट परिवेशका लागि गतिविधि र विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.note: Section heading rather than an activity instruction.

rows.en: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS considerations and support into clinical case management for infectious diseases
rows.ne: 4.1 सरुवा रोगको क्लिनिकल केस व्यवस्थापनमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष र सहयोग एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS-related considerations and support into the clinical case management of communicable diseases.
rows.note: Frozen T112 and T242 specify communicable diseases, which are not necessarily coextensive with the source category of infectious diseases. bt-divergence: Frozen T112 and T242 render infectious diseases as communicable diseases, potentially excluding infectious diseases that are not transmissible. Frozen wording retained.

rows.en: MHPSS considerations and activities are appropriately integrated in specific types of emergency situations
rows.ne: MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष र गतिविधिहरू विशेष प्रकारका आपत्कालीन परिस्थितिहरूमा उपयुक्त रूपमा एकीकृत गरिन्छन्।
rows.bt: Considerations and activities related to MHPSS are appropriately integrated into specific types of emergency situations.

rows.en: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to persons deprived of their liberty
rows.ne: 4.2 स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूलाई मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to persons deprived of liberty.
rows.note: The supplied ambiguity identifies an unresolved discrepancy between this overview label and the contents or activity heading; the local source wording is retained.
